# 检查 4 个进程
echo "=== PROCESSES ==="
ps -p 20073,22466,22904,22095 -o pid,rss,etime,args --no-headers 2>/dev/null

# GPU 状态
echo "=== GPU ==="
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv

# 系统内存
echo "=== MEMORY ==="
free -h | head -2

# 各实验当前 step
echo "=== STEPS ==="
for dir in random_reweight_seed123 bs8_auto_nmin_seed42 batch_adaptive_tau_rho06_seed42 rho02_adaptive_tau09_seed42; do
  f=$(find /root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/ -path "*${dir}*/step_metrics.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$f" ]; then
    echo "$dir: $(tail -1 $f)"
  else
    f2=$(find /dev/shm/output/models/ -path "*${dir}*/step_metrics.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -n "$f2" ]; then
      echo "$dir: $(tail -1 $f2)"
    else
      echo "$dir: no metrics file found"
    fi
  fi
done
